instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a shallow depth of field, captured in a medium shot at eye-level. On an outdoor wooden boardwalk with a metal railing, backed by a dense forest of green trees, two men are embracing. On the left, the man in the orange t-shirt (R2) stands facing right, hugging the man in the grey t-shirt (R4) who stands on the right facing left with his back to the camera. The warm embrace is captured in soft, natural daylight filtering through the trees, creating a sun-drenched and affectionate atmosphere.
